public.fn_cockpit_ctx_programacao.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cockpit_ctx_programacao(p_programacao_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(programacao_id uuid, os_id uuid, origem text, produto_id uuid, microrganismo_id uuid, cliente_id uuid, partner_order_id uuid, volume_necessario numeric, status_os text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE pp record;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO pp FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id = p_programacao_id;
  IF pp IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COCKPIT_PROGRAMACAO_NAO_ENCONTRADA'; END IF;

  IF pp.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT pp.id, os.id, 'onfarm'::text, coalesce(pp.produto_id, os.produto_id),
             coalesce(pp.microrganismo_id, os.microrganismo_id), os.cliente_id,
             NULL::uuid, coalesce(pp.volume_necessario, 0), os.status::text
        FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm os
       WHERE os.id = pp.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
  ELSIF pp.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT pp.id, os.id,
             CASE WHEN os.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'b2b' ELSE 'manual' END,
             coalesce(pp.produto_id, os.produto_id),
             coalesce(pp.microrganismo_id, os.microrganismo_id), os.cliente_id,
             os.partner_order_id, coalesce(pp.volume_necessario, 0), os.status::text
        FROM public.ordens_servico os
       WHERE os.id = pp.ordem_servico_id;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COCKPIT_PROGRAMACAO_SEM_OS';
  END IF;
END;
$function$;

public.fn_cockpit_is_gestor.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cockpit_is_gestor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::app_role)
      OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::app_role)
$function$;

public.fn_estoque_fingerprint.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_estoque_fingerprint(p_acao text, p_item uuid, p_qtd numeric, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(extensions.digest(
    'estmovv1|'||coalesce(p_acao,'')||'|'||coalesce(p_item::text,'')||'|'||
    coalesce(trim_scale(p_qtd)::text,'')||'|'||
    coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k, v ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_each(coalesce(p_payload,'{}'::jsonb)) e(k,v))::text,'{}'),
    'sha256'),'hex');
$function$;

public.fn_estoque_pode_operar.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_estoque_pode_operar(_uid uuid, _acao text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _uid IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN _acao IN ('ajuste','perda','descarte')
      THEN public.has_role(_uid,'administrador'::app_role) OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor'::app_role)
        OR public.has_role(_uid,'producao'::app_role)
    ELSE public.has_role(_uid,'administrador'::app_role) OR public.has_role(_uid,'gestor'::app_role)
      OR public.has_role(_uid,'producao'::app_role) OR public.has_role(_uid,'administrativo'::app_role)
  END;
$function$;

platform_private.guard_manual_lot_delete.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_delete_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao p WHERE p.id=OLD.programacao_id AND p.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.laboratorio_esteira_eventos e WHERE e.lote_id=OLD.id AND e.origem_os='manual')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MANUAL_LOT_DELETE_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN OLD;
END $function$;

platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 p public.programacao_producao%ROWTYPE;
 old_manual boolean:=false;
 old_programacao uuid;
 org uuid;
BEGIN
 -- Lock old/new parents in deterministic order. An UPDATE cannot escape the
 -- manual fence by changing programacao_id to onfarm or NULL.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN old_programacao:=OLD.programacao_id; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
 WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id OR id=old_programacao
 ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
    WHERE id=OLD.programacao_id AND ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL) INTO old_manual;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id;
 IF old_manual OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND old_manual THEN
   org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
   IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND org IS NOT NULL AND public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
    AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'producao')) IS TRUE
    AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL AND p.organization_id=org AND NEW.organization_id=org AND OLD.organization_id=org
    AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status'-'updated_at') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status'-'updated_at')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org AND o.status::text='em_cq'
     AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
    AND ((OLD.status::text='em_producao' AND NEW.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_send_v1' AND target=NEW.id))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado','reprovado') AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_'||NEW.status::text||'_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.controle_qualidade c WHERE c.lote_id=NEW.id AND c.organization_id=org AND c.resultado::text=NEW.status::text
      AND c.responsavel='DADOS FICTICIOS SEM VALOR COMERCIAL' AND c.ph IS NOT NULL AND c.concentracao IS NOT NULL)))
   THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  -- No JWT/GUC/current_user/service-role escape: only the reviewed insert RPC
  -- can issue this private, target-specific ticket; it removes it after INSERT.
  org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR org IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS NULL
   OR public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
   OR p.id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL
   OR p.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org
   OR p.produto_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.produto_id OR p.microrganismo_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.microrganismo_id
   OR p.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'aguardando' OR NEW.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'em_producao'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org
     AND o.status::text='programada' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL
     AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets
     WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current() AND scope='manual_lot_insert_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MANUAL_LOT_WRITE_REQUIRES_REVIEWED_RPC' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$;

platform_private.guard_manual_program_bi.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_program_binding_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL
 AND ROW(NEW.id,NEW.ordem_servico_id,NEW.ordem_servico_onfarm_id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.produto_id,NEW.microrganismo_id)
 IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.ordem_servico_id,OLD.ordem_servico_onfarm_id,OLD.organization_id,OLD.produto_id,OLD.microrganismo_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.lotes l WHERE l.programacao_id=OLD.id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MANUAL_PROGRAM_BINDING_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$;

public.stock_p1_lote_owned.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stock_p1_lote_owned(p_lote uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.stock_p1_lote_owned(p_lote); $function$;

platform_private.stock_p1_lote_owned.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.stock_p1_lote_owned(p_lote uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public.lotes l
   WHERE l.id = p_lote AND l.organization_id IS NOT NULL
     AND l.organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()
 );
$function$;

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''

platform_private.stock_p1_movement_owned.definition:

public.fn_ledger_append_only.definition:

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'estoque_movimentacoes e append-only: % nao permitido', TG_OP
    USING ERRCODE = '42501';
END;
$function$;

public.tg_protect_os_structural_fields.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_protect_os_structural_fields()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.origem IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origem
     OR NEW.partner_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_order_id
     OR NEW.partner_order_item_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_order_item_id
     OR NEW.produto_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.produto_id
     OR NEW.numero_os IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.numero_os
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Campos estruturais da OS (origem, vínculo B2B, produto, número) não podem ser alterados.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$;

public.fn_estoque_ctx_force.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_estoque_ctx_force(p_ctx jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM set_config('app.estoque_mov_ctx', COALESCE(p_ctx, '{}'::jsonb)::text, true);
END; $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_estoque_ctx_close()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM set_config('app.estoque_mov_ctx', '', true);
END; $function$;

public.lote_volume_envasado.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lote_volume_envasado(_lote_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(volume_por_unidade,0) * COALESCE(quantidade,0)), 0)::numeric
  FROM public.envase
  WHERE lote_id = _lote_id;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()
